user_query: I want to find tweets that contain the hashtag 'love' and were posted by the user with the username 'justinbieber'. Can you give me these tweets? I'm only interested in tweets that have at least 500 retweets and 200 likes. Please make sure the tweets are in English.

TaskList.description: Fetch tweets from the user 'justinbieber' containing the hashtag 'love'.
Filter the fetched tweets to include only those with at least 500 retweets and 200 likes.
Translate any non-English tweets to English (if applicable).
